mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate below 1.0% compresses discount rates for equity cash flows, increasing present value of future earnings and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as market participants adjust valuation models.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 1.0%, or Rank IC over 3 years falls below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in the federal funds rate above 1.0% signals imminent monetary tightening, raising real interest rates and reducing equity valuation multiples, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS exceeds 1.0%, or Rank IC over 3 years falls below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts and retail sales indicate collapsing consumer demand, reducing corporate revenue visibility and triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days through earnings downgrades.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline by >0.5% MoM, or Rank IC over 3 years falls below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: High unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 4.5%) signal deteriorating labor market conditions, increasing recession risk and reducing corporate hiring budgets, which drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 4.5%, or Rank IC over 3 years falls below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: Strong payroll growth (PAYEMS > 100k monthly) indicates robust labor market conditions, boosting consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS growth exceeds 100k, or Rank IC over 3 years falls below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 100 (index 2017=100) signals manufacturing contraction, reducing corporate output capacity and profit margins, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO is below 100, or Rank IC over 3 years falls below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent declines in housing starts and quarterly GDP growth indicate broad economic weakness, reducing corporate revenue expectations and triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days through sector-wide earnings revisions.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when both HOUST and GDPC1 decline by >0.5% MoM and QoQ, or Rank IC over 3 years falls below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: High inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 245) prompt aggressive monetary policy expectations, increasing real interest rates and reducing equity valuation multiples, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL exceeds 245, or Rank IC over 3 years falls below 0.05.
